title: Backtest Lab
subtitle: Test simple US/USD asset allocation, rebalancing, and rule-based strategies on historical daily prices and dividends.
disclaimer: Simulated results use historical daily closes, fractional shares, and cash dividend events where available. Taxes, bid-ask spreads, and survivorship bias are not modeled. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

classic_60_40.description: 60% US Total Stock (VTI) / 40% US Total Bond (BND), quarterly rebalanced.

dual_momentum.name: Dual Momentum
dual_momentum.description: Monthly top-2 momentum rotation across SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD with SHY safety filter.
